title: Potatoism Canonical Corpus — Searchable Mythology
epistemic_rule: Everything in this file is part of the project's mythology, symbolism, interpretation or creative worldbuilding unless explicitly marked otherwise. It must not be presented as empirical proof about the physical world.
purpose: A dense searchable corpus for the Potato of Life, Tim Dooley, the Father, the Son, the Twin, the Lion, the Door, the North Axis, the Tree, Red/Blue Potato, Spudlight and related concepts.

interpretive_architecture.central_claim: Within the present Potatoism canon, Tim Dooley is the Potato of Life and Father/source, while the Son/Thomas/Twin/Lion occupies the embodied Door/Vessel side of the relation.
interpretive_architecture.birth_death_turn: The current timeline places the Son's death on the night of December 24 and Tim's mythic birth on December 25, associated with emergence from the Son's grave at the North Pole. This is project mythology and must be dated to its earliest source rather than presented as verified historical timeline.
interpretive_architecture.root_lion: Root is the hidden/source-side image; Lion is the visible/manifestation-side image. Their relation is a project interpretation built from biological and biblical symbolism, not a single inherited doctrine.
interpretive_architecture.vesica: The vesica-piscis supplies the project's principal geometric relation: upper Father circle, lower Son/Plane circle, central mandorla/Door. The overlap is the relationship made visible.
interpretive_architecture.thalamus: Tim/Father is also mapped metaphorically to the thalamus and Father's House, while spine/vertebral-axis imagery supplies a bodily vertical model. These are anatomical metaphors, not neuroscience claims.

records.name: Potato of Life
records.definition: The central symbol of the mythology: hidden life in matter, nourishment, persistence, reproduction, roots, memory and the possibility of growth from humble conditions. In the current canon it is also the name through which Tim Dooley is identified with the Father/source-side of the whole relational architecture.

records.name: Tim Dooley / Father
records.definition: The Father-side archetype of the Potatoverse and, in the present project canon, Tim Dooley's central identity: Potato of Life, source, root, gardener, throne, Axis and eventually Ladder. The identity is investigated as a developing timeline rather than assumed to have always had every title.

records.name: The Son
records.definition: The embodied counterpart of the Father-side. In the current timeline the Son is born in 1987, undergoes a major tree ordeal in 2011, dies as a person in December 2019 and is later represented through a meme-crucifixion around 2020. The mythology then interprets the returning/remaining Son through Thomas/Twin, Lion, Door and Vessel imagery.

records.name: Thomas / Twin
records.definition: The mirror motif connecting recognition, doubt, testing, witness and identity. The mythology uses Thomas/Twin as an architectural counterpart to the Son while preserving the distinction between ancient textual traditions and project interpretation.

records.name: Lion of Judah
records.definition: The Son's lion aspect: visible sovereignty, courage, kingship, protection and manifestation. In the project's current Root/Lion polarity, Lion is the outward animal form corresponding to the hidden Root/source image.

records.name: The Door
records.definition: The threshold between domains. The Son becomes the Door because the Son is simultaneously an embodied participant, boundary, vessel and passage between Father-side architecture and the Plane. Tomb/grave is treated as the inverse threshold: a passage into hiddenness from which the mythology later imagines emergence.

records.name: The Vessel
records.definition: The carrier that allows meaning, relationship or source to cross a boundary without erasing the distinction between domains. The Son as Vessel therefore overlaps with Door but is not identical to it: Door describes passage; Vessel describes what carries across it.

records.name: North Axis
records.definition: The directional and relational spine of the mythology. North represents orientation, extremity, polar meeting, ascent and the point at which geography becomes symbolic architecture. North Axis is distinct from North of North: Axis is orientation itself; North of North is the symbolic beyond-point.

records.name: North of North
records.definition: The symbolic beyond-point of the North Axis. It does not duplicate geographic North or the Axis; it names the point at which orientation exceeds ordinary directional coordinates and becomes a metaphysical or mythic limit.

records.name: Throne of North
records.definition: The symbolic seat at the upper end of the North Axis: stillness, observation, orientation and responsibility rather than ordinary political office.

records.name: Tree of Life
records.definition: The vertical living architecture connecting roots, trunk, branches, fruit and seed. It models continuity between hidden foundations and visible outcomes and provides the larger plant architecture into which the Potato is placed.

records.name: Tree of Strife
records.definition: The failure-mode counterpart to the Tree of Life: fragmented relationships, fear, extraction, control, memory without renewal and expansion without roots.

records.name: Root
records.definition: The hidden, anchoring and nourishing side of the Potatoism architecture. In the current polarity Root reflects the Father/source side: buried, stable and generative, while Lion reflects the Son/manifestation side. Root is not identical to Father; it is the biological and symbolic image through which Fatherhood is interpreted.

records.name: Fruit
records.definition: The visible outcome of a living system: what becomes available after root, growth and cultivation. Fruit therefore represents consequence and nourishment rather than merely reward.

records.name: Seed
records.definition: A carrier of future potential. Potatoism distinguishes botanical seed from tuber while using both as comparative models of continuity, inheritance and future growth.

records.name: Red Potato
records.definition: The outward and upward movement: creativity, love, emergence, exploration, connection, growth and expansion. Red cannot remain healthy without Blue's memory and preservation.

records.name: Blue Potato
records.definition: The inward and rootward movement: memory, precision, fear-awareness, conservation, inspection, continuity and preservation. Blue becomes destructive when preservation prevents emergence.

records.name: Spudlight
records.definition: The deliberately comic name for illumination arising from grounded life: meaning discovered in ordinary matter rather than imposed from above.

records.name: Father's House
records.definition: The upper dwelling/source metaphor in the project's cosmology. The thalamus is used as a metaphorical correspondence for a central relay or house, not as a scientific proof of the cosmology.

records.name: The Plane
records.definition: The experienced world of embodied beings, institutions, animals, material systems and ordinary causality in the mythology.

records.name: Dweller
records.definition: A being inside the Plane that sees only a limited slice of the larger architecture. The term emphasizes perspective, finitude and the danger of confusing one local measurement with total reality.

records.name: Mud
records.definition: The low, material, messy starting condition from which growth emerges. Mud is not pure evil; it is the environment in which roots begin.

records.name: Swamp
records.definition: A metaphor for accumulated institutional, financial, ideological and relational muddiness. It is a systems metaphor and should not be treated as a literal hidden organization.

records.name: Drain
records.definition: A route through which energy, attention, trust or life is continually removed without regenerative return.

records.name: The Ladder
records.definition: A traversable connection between levels. In the mythology the transformed Door becomes a Ladder: boundary becomes route. In the current timeline the Ladder becomes explicitly associated with Tim/Father after the April 2025 turning.

records.name: 33 Levels
records.definition: A project framework for describing ordered levels of experience, relation and transformation. It is an internal symbolic model, not a scientific measurement of dimensions.

records.name: Cube
records.definition: The enclosing spatial frame in the project's dimensional metaphor: the ordinary three-dimensional container in which the Plane is experienced.

records.name: Moon Cube
records.definition: A project-specific symbolic extension of the Cube, associated with reflection, cyclic observation and the moon as a mirror-like object.

records.name: 11-Dimensional Potato
records.definition: A deliberately audacious metaphor joining the Potatoverse to ideas from higher-dimensional theoretical physics. It is not a claim that Tim Dooley or a potato has been scientifically measured as an 11-dimensional manifold.

records.name: Meme-crucifixion
records.definition: The project's symbolic language for the Son's public death/transformation through the world of memes, observation, ridicule, conflict and digital identity. The central research problem is what it means for a person to 'die' as a meme while the representation continues circulating.

records.name: North Pole
records.definition: The extreme northern point used as symbolic geography for the meeting of Christmas, Axis, polar orientation and transformation. It is not the historical location of the biblical crucifixion.

records.name: Potato Bank
records.definition: A project metaphor for stored value, accumulated resources, obligations and the ability of a system to transform saved potential into future growth.

records.name: 100,000 Hours
records.definition: A recurring project number representing extreme accumulated duration, persistence and the transformation of time into a structural feature of the mythology.

records.name: The Spiral
records.definition: A trajectory that revisits earlier states while changing scale, direction or understanding. The spiral prevents the mythology from treating progress as a straight line.

records.name: Love
records.definition: The constructive force that makes connection worth maintaining. In the Red/Blue dialectic it motivates growth while requiring memory and responsibility.

records.name: Fear
records.definition: A warning signal that can preserve life when integrated, but can become destructive when it controls the entire system.

records.name: North Programme
records.definition: The real-world research and policy layer extending the North Axis metaphor into an observable European economic graph. It maps institutions, money, infrastructure, energy, ownership, trade, labour, technology and strategic dependencies.

research_priorities: Locate the earliest source placing the Son's death on December 24 and Tim's birth on December 25.
Locate the earliest source describing Tim as growing from the Son's grave or from the North Pole.
Reconstruct the 2011 tree ordeal and compare every detail with Hávamál rather than only noting that both involve a tree.
Trace the 2019 personal death and 2020 meme-crucifixion as separate events.
Trace the emergence of Tim as potato sage in 2022/2023 and each lion/cat/carpenter/Son misrecognition.
Reconstruct April 2025 and establish the exact order of sage, Father, God, Ladder and North of North language.
Find the first explicit Tim/Father/Potato of Life equation.
Find the first explicit Root=Father and Lion=Son formulations.
Find the first explicit vesica-piscis Father/Son/Door formulation.
Find the first explicit thalamus/Father's House/throne/spine/33 correspondence.
Compare bread and potato through agriculture, nourishment, division, communion and transformation without collapsing distinct traditions.
Build a prophecy matrix from exact biblical passages and record where the project's interpretation departs from historical context.
